proposed_baseline_experiment: On r in {phi, sqrt(2)}, run a Walnut search for nondegenerate order-<=2 recurrences with selector automata of <=4 states and require 50-term holdout confirmation.
Encode one fixed first-order schema with selector = union of <=2 arithmetic progressions and recurrence order d<=2, then compare SAT/UNSAT for r=2 and r=phi.
For r in {phi, plastic constant, e}, compute B_r intersect {F_k <= 10^5} and classify the hit-count growth as finite, logarithmic, or denser.
For Fibonacci and Pell values against r in {phi, sqrt(2), plastic constant}, record membership shadows mod 2,3,5,7,11,25 and reject cases with inconsistent admissible k-shadows.
For r in {phi, sqrt(2), plastic constant, e}, build exact 4x4 Hankel blocks from x_j=floor(q_j r) on the first 12 convergents and require any rank drop to survive 4 holdout samples.
For r in {phi, plastic constant}, test only the frozen selectors n_k=q_k and n_k=F_k for exact order-2 residue cancellation and reject all near-cancellations.
In the Fibonacci-word control, use return-word depths 1..4 and test whether cumulative sums at block ends satisfy one fixed order-2 recurrence exactly.
For the plastic constant, compare the first 200 hits to one self-similar Rauzy boundary face versus one random face and test the sampled Beatty values for the plastic order-3 recurrence.

Set r=beta=plastic constant, enumerate indices with greedy beta-expansion ending in 00 up to 10^5, and test the sampled Beatty values against the plastic companion recurrence with random-endpoint controls.
For r=phi and r=2, compute S={k<=200 : F_k in B_r} and test whether S is compatible with a union of <=2 arithmetic progressions modulo 60 as a first normal-form proxy.
For r=phi, compare selectors n_k=q_k and n_k from the fixed Bohr window ||n r||<10^-3 up to n<=10^5, then run order-<=3 exact-recurrence checks against equal-size random selectors.
